show.description: Kabir Malhotra is a poor construction worker who knows he is the grandson of a billionaire but refuses to accept that identity. Betrayed by his girlfriend and crushed by a ruthless tycoon, Kabir’s life collapses when his mother’s life is at risk. A shocking contract marriage with a powerful businesswoman forces him to face his legacy, turning a man who rejected wealth into a threat no empire can ignore.
